verdict.rationale: Sift is a developer-facing fraud-detection SaaS, so publishing llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair axis. The evidence shows only a conventional human-oriented API reference portal with per-language examples and versioned changelogs. Nothing mentions llms.txt, markdown-for-LLM docs, or any documentation designed for agent consumption.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
